sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the verified static requirement: it uses the canonical ship-owned grossTonnage path with the verified unitless quantity and inclusive >= 500 applicability, requires at least two distinct typed nonMagneticHeadingMeans nodes, and checks each means for both power connections and an independence relation to another distinct means on the same ship. Deterministic validation is valid and no canonical vocabulary repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add and use the canonical gross-tonnage property on the ship, with the verified datatype/unit, and enforce applicability at gross tonnage >= 500 using an inclusive comparison. The current query only evaluates topology after two distinct heading means already exist, so an applicable ship with zero or one means incorrectly passes; enforce at least two distinct nonMagneticHeadingMeans nodes, then require each to have both power connections and an independence relation to another distinct means on the same ship. Preserve the supplied owner/path structure and do not replace applicability with a convenience boolean.

Preserve the prior instruction and current ship-owned grossTonnage path, inclusive gross-tonnage applicability, and per-means power and independence checks. Repair the conditional count: the current FILTER NOT EXISTS rejects when two distinct means exist, so zero or one means incorrectly passes; instead emit a violation unless at least two distinct hasNonMagneticHeadingMeans nodes exist. Also use the verified QUDT unit IRI http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/UNITLESS, not qudt:UNITLESS under the schema namespace.

Preserve the prior grossTonnage path, unitless QUDT quantity, inclusive >= 500 applicability, distinct-count violation logic, and per-means power and independence checks. Repair the heading-means identity boundary: the query currently counts and validates arbitrary objects of hasNonMagneticHeadingMeans without requiring them to be typed nltl:nonMagneticHeadingMeans, so non-heading objects can satisfy the requirement. Add a class constraint for nltl:nonMagneticHeadingMeans to the hasNonMagneticHeadingMeans value shape and require that class for each current means node in every relevant SPARQL branch, while retaining the same-ship distinct-other-means condition. Keep connectedToMainPower and connectedToEmergencyPower on their supplied nonMagneticHeadingMeans owner; do not relocate them based on the conflicting domain metadata.

The candidate faithfully encodes the verified static requirement: it uses the canonical ship-owned grossTonnage path with the verified unitless quantity and inclusive >= 500 applicability, requires at least two distinct typed nonMagneticHeadingMeans nodes, and checks each means for both power connections and an independence relation to another distinct means on the same ship. Deterministic validation is valid and no canonical vocabulary repair is required.
